Disaggregation here means splitting the workload into different parts to optimize performance. Under frontend pressure, the cluster must handle high traffic, so the analysis needs to show how these components work under stress.

Request routing is the process of directing requests to the appropriate GPU. With disaggregation, maybe there are multiple GPUs, so the routing needs to handle multiple requests efficiently. Queueing is about managing incoming requests
